00001 MODULE mc_toolbox
00002 
00003   !  Here one can specify parameters to be used  by the functions
00004   INTEGER(KIND=4), PARAMETER :: GSEED=12345
00005   REAL(KIND=8), PARAMETER :: MEANVAL=0.00
00006   REAL(KIND=8), PARAMETER :: SDEV=2.00
00007 
00008   CONTAINS
00009     FUNCTION rgamma(a)
00010       ! This function returns a random number with a Gamma PDF using
00011       ! the method described by Marsaglia and Tsang 2000.
00012       IMPLICIT NONE
00013 
00014       ! Data dictionary: Calling parameters
00015       REAL(KIND=8), INTENT(IN) :: a
00016       REAL(KIND=8)             :: rgamma
00017 
00018       ! Data dictionary: Local variables
00019       REAL(KIND=8)             :: d,c,v
00020       REAL(KIND=8)             :: x,u
00021 
00022       d = a-1./3.
00023       c = 1./SQRT(9.*d)
00024       rgamma = 0.
00025       DO
00026         v = 0.
00027         DO WHILE ( v .LE. 0. )
00028           x = R8_NORMAL_AB(MEANVAL,SDEV)
00029           v = 1. + c*x
00030         END DO
00031 !        PRINT *, 'x=',x,'and v=',v
00032         v = v*v*v
00033 !        u = RANDOM()
00034         CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(u)
00035         IF ( u .LT. 1.-0.331*(x*x)*(x*x) ) THEN
00036 !          PRINT *, 'Success-1!'
00037           rgamma = (d*v)
00038           GOTO 10
00039         ELSE IF ( DLOG(u) .LT. 0.5*x*x+d*(1.-v+DLOG(v)) ) THEN
00040 !          PRINT *, 'Success-2!'
00041           rgamma = (d*v)
00042           GOTO 10
00043         END IF
00044       END DO
00045 10    RETURN
00046     END FUNCTION rgamma

00048 FUNCTION r8_normal_01 ()
00049 !*****************************************************************************80
00050 !
00051 !! R8_NORMAL_01 returns a unit pseudonormal R8.
00052 !
00053 !  Discussion:
00054 !
00055 !    The standard normal probability distribution function (PDF) has
00056 !    mean 0 and standard deviation 1.
00057 !
00058 !  Licensing:
00059 !
00060 !    This code is distributed under the GNU LGPL license.
00061 !
00062 !  Modified:
00063 !
00064 !    06 August 2013
00065 !
00066 !  Author:
00067 !
00068 !    John Burkardt
00069 !
00070 !  Parameters:
00071 !
00072 !    Input/output, integer ( kind = 4 ) SEED, a seed for the random
00073 !    number generator.
00074 !
00075 !    Output, real ( kind = 8 ) R8_NORMAL_01, a normally distributed
00076 !    random value.
00077 !
00078   implicit none
00079 
00080   real ( kind = 8 ) r1
00081   real ( kind = 8 ) r2
00082   real ( kind = 8 ) r8_normal_01
00083   real ( kind = 8 ), parameter :: r8_pi = 3.141592653589793D+00
00084   real ( kind = 8 ) x
00085 
00086 !  r1 = RANDOM()
00087 !  r2 = RAND()
00088   ! Here we'll use a couple of random numbers generated using the built in
00089   ! RNG of the compiler and previously defined seed
00090   CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(r1)
00091   CALL RANDOM_NUMBER(r2)
00092   x = sqrt( - 2.0D+00 * DLOG( r1 ) ) * cos( 2.0D+00 * r8_pi * r2 )
00093 
00094   r8_normal_01 = x
00095 
00096   return
00097 END FUNCTION r8_normal_01

00099 FUNCTION r8_uniform_01 ( seedy )
00100 
00101 !*****************************************************************************80
00102 !
00103 !! R8_UNIFORM_01 returns a unit pseudorandom R8.
00104 !
00105 !  Discussion:
00106 !
00107 !    This routine implements the recursion
00108 !
00109 !      seed = 16807 * seed mod ( 2^31 - 1 )
00110 !      r8_uniform_01 = seed / ( 2^31 - 1 )
00111 !
00112 !    The integer arithmetic never requires more than 32 bits,
00113 !    including a sign bit.
00114 !
00115 !    If the initial seed is 12345, then the first three computations are
00116 !
00117 !      Input     Output      R8_UNIFORM_01
00118 !      SEED      SEED
00119 !
00120 !         12345   207482415  0.096616
00121 !     207482415  1790989824  0.833995
00122 !    1790989824  2035175616  0.947702
00123 !
00124 !  Licensing:
00125 !
00126 !    This code is distributed under the GNU LGPL license.
00127 !
00128 !  Modified:
00129 !
00130 !    31 May 2007
00131 !
00132 !  Author:
00133 !
00134 !    John Burkardt
00135 !
00136 !  Reference:
00137 !
00138 !    Paul Bratley, Bennett Fox, Linus Schrage,
00139 !    A Guide to Simulation,
00140 !    Second Edition,
00141 !    Springer, 1987,
00142 !    ISBN: 0387964673,
00143 !    LC: QA76.9.C65.B73.
00144 !
00145 !    Bennett Fox,
00146 !    Algorithm 647:
00147 !    Implementation and Relative Efficiency of Quasirandom
00148 !    Sequence Generators,
00149 !    ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software,
00150 !    Volume 12, Number 4, December 1986, pages 362-376.
00151 !
00152 !    Pierre L'Ecuyer,
00153 !    Random Number Generation,
00154 !    in Handbook of Simulation,
00155 !    edited by Jerry Banks,
00156 !    Wiley, 1998,
00157 !    ISBN: 0471134031,
00158 !    LC: T57.62.H37.
00159 !
00160 !    Peter Lewis, Allen Goodman, James Miller,
00161 !    A Pseudo-Random Number Generator for the System/360,
00162 !    IBM Systems Journal,
00163 !    Volume 8, 1969, pages 136-143.
00164 !
00165 !  Parameters:
00166 !
00167 !    Input/output, integer ( kind = 4 ) SEED, the "seed" value, which
00168 !    should NOT be 0.
00169 !    On output, SEED has been updated.
00170 !
00171 !    Output, real ( kind = 8 ) R8_UNIFORM_01, a new pseudorandom variate,
00172 !    strictly between 0 and 1.
00173 !
00174   implicit none
00175 
00176   integer ( kind = 4 ) k
00177   real ( kind = 8 ) r8_uniform_01
00178   integer ( kind = 4 ) seedy
00179 
00180   PRINT *, '*******/Now in R8_UNIFORM_01/*******'
00181   PRINT *, 'Seed is:',seedy
00182   k = seedy / 127773
00183   PRINT *, 'k=',k
00184   seedy = 16807 * ( seedy - k * 127773 ) - k * 2836
00185   PRINT *, 'seedy now =',seedy
00186 
00187 
00188   if ( seedy < 0 ) then
00189     seedy = seedy + 2147483647
00190   end if
00191 !
00192 !  Although SEED can be represented exactly as a 32 bit integer,
00193 !  it generally cannot be represented exactly as a 32 bit real number!
00194 !
00195   r8_uniform_01 = real ( seedy, kind = 8 ) * 4.656612875D-10
00196   PRINT *, 'The uniform RN is:',r8_uniform_01
00197   return
00198 END FUNCTION r8_uniform_01
